input_units.lag1: prior calendar month unique ODINO count

limitations: Historical quote parsing merges complete physical source records; exact replay does not validate counts
No as-issued publication or product-label revision history is reconstructed
Received reports are not incidents, defect probabilities or fleet-normalized risk
Whole month groups share vehicles and overlapping observed histories; online test history permitted
Only complaint payload/layout are needed; other archives and personal/narrative fields are excluded

numerical_policy.source_record_mode: historical quote-aware decoder; literal record mismatch explicitly blocks admission
numerical_policy.split_policy: original latest whole development months and final three confirmation months unchanged

reference_parser_provenance.reuse: Quote-aware historical counts and sample/cohort identities preserved for diagnosis; literal TSV record-boundary audit independently implemented; no evaluator or reference state copied
